slots.note: One daily carousel upload. It contains six two-sign comparison units and covers all 12 signs exactly once. Exact card count follows the approved daily source pack and platform limits; never split into six separate uploads.

platforms.facebook: Native carousel for card slots; Reel for narrated video slots.
platforms.instagram: Native carousel for card slots; Reel for narrated video slots.
platforms.tiktok: Native photo post for card slots using silent JPEG/WebP 1080x1080 cards and autoAddMusic=true; normal video for narrated slots with auto-music off.

special_visual_rules.zodiac: One daily zodiac carousel upload at 11:00. It must contain six two-sign comparison units covering all twelve signs exactly once. Every comparison must visibly identify both signs. Never split this standing series into six separate uploads; obsolete single-sign formats are hard failures.
special_visual_rules.dog_bartender: Exactly four cards. Same recurring photorealistic brown dog in every card, clearly functioning as bartender in a believable real bar. Different scene/composition per card. No cartoon/animation.
